notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vazi.
You have created at least two Treasure tokens this turn.
description:
Cast Crafty Cutpurse by paying {3}{U}.
Crafty Cutpurse enters the battlefield, causing all tokens that would be created under an opponent's control this turn to be created under your control instead.
Activate Vazi by tapping it, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vazi.
Repeat from step 3.
